entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been trying to return this useless VeloBand Pulse for over a month and your company is making it impossible! I want my money back, now!

I can certainly look into that for you, and I understand your frustration. To start, could you help me understand what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?

The issue is your whole system is a joke! I tried to return it back in December, and there was a massive website error. The whole thing was just a blank screen! I couldn't get a label, I couldn't print anything. The entire system was down!
I'm very sorry to hear you had that experience. Let me just pull up your purchase history... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor was delivered to you on December 15th. Is that correct?

Yes, that's right! And I tried to return it on the 24th, well within any sane return window. I even took a screenshot of the error page to prove it! If you're going to give me any trouble, just get me your manager right now.

I can absolutely resolve this for you, there's no need to escalate the call. I do see a log of a known service interruption around that date, so I appreciate you clarifying. However, it looks like that won't even be a factor here.
What do you mean 'not a factor'? Are you trying to get out of this?

Not at all, sir. I'm just checking our return policy, and all VeloFit items are eligible for a full refund within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 41, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a return.
Oh. Ninety days? I thought the paper in the box said something much shorter... Well, okay then. So you'll take it back?

Yes, of course. I've just processed the return authorization and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Huh. That was... much easier than I was expecting. Alright, well, thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
Wonderful. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
